'''Hallen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], Hallen was discovered during her adolescent years by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and taken to the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to begin [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She delievered a message from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]] to [[The Barsen'thor|her Padawan]] telling the apprentice to practice martial arts, pointing him out to Master [[Wettle]], who could train the Padawan in the arts.<ref name="TOR" />
